title: Stand at the rim of Meteor Crater
description: At Meteor Crater in Arizona, walk from the visitor center to a lookout and face an impact site much larger than it appears in pictures. Exhibits help explain how a space rock struck the desert and what the crater taught scientists. The experience is simple: stand at the edge, let your eyes trace the rim, and imagine the force that made it.
teaser: Look across an asteroid impact crater in Arizona.
goodToKnow: Choose observation rather than a longer rim tour; check stairs and accessible viewpoints.
whyItMightDelightYou: It is a direct encounter with evidence that the story of Earth includes events from far beyond it.
